therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Multiple myeloma cell death and disease control
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Multiple myeloma patients with one or two prior autologous transplants
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: VTD regimen with melphalan efficacy assessment
